en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Creators prepare for Grand Theft Auto VI’s “moon landing” moment

entries.headline: Minecraft Dungeons II’s first DLC, The Humblers Awaken, arrives December 1
entries.summary: Xbox Wire says The Humblers Awaken, the first DLC for Minecraft Dungeons II, will arrive on December 1. The fixed packet confirms only the name and date, so no gameplay, price, or platform details are inferred.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire page supports the DLC name and December 1 date; the copy is intentionally limited to those facts.
entries.timeNote: Published at 18:43 Beijing time on November 16, inside the fixed edition window; the DLC date is December 1, 2026.

entries.headline: Top creators prepare for Grand Theft Auto VI’s “moon landing” moment
entries.summary: IGN interviewed YouTube and streaming creators who said Rockstar had not provided them with the full game in advance. Twitch community marketing head Mary Kish compared each GTA launch to a generational moon landing, while TGG, with 2.32 million subscribers, is preparing for an intensive launch period.
entries.verification: The opened IGN feature separates attributed quotes, creator preparations, and brand events from broader expectations about the launch.
entries.timeNote: Published at 00:44 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed edition window; cited launch events run November 18–19.

entries.headline: DAVE THE DIVER and Core Keeper launch a free two-way crossover on November 30
entries.summary: Fireshine Games, Pugstorm, and MINTROCKET announced a permanent free crossover. DAVE THE DIVER will first add a defense minigame on Steam, while Core Keeper adds Sunken Sea content, pets, and equipment across all platforms; other DAVE THE DIVER platforms follow later.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the companies, free and permanent status, different content in each game, and the staggered platform rollout.
entries.timeNote: Published at 09:26 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed edition window; the crossover starts November 30, 2026.

entries.headline: Splatoon 3 version 12.0.0 arrives November 17 with two-player X Battle teams
entries.summary: Nintendo says Splatoon 3 version 12.0.0 launches November 17. Traditional X Battles will test two-friend teams; changes explicitly marked for Nintendo Switch 2 apply only there, while all other changes cover both Switch 2 and Switch.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu snapshot attributes the announcement to Nintendo and distinguishes Switch 2-only adjustments from changes shared by both platforms.
entries.timeNote: Published at 09:44 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed edition window; the update launches the same day.

entries.headline: Shigeru Miyamoto named the inaugural AIAS Legend Award recipient
entries.summary: The Academy of Interactive Arts and Sciences will present its first Legend Award to Shigeru Miyamoto. The honor is intended for one recipient per decade, and AIAS says his influence across generations meets the award’s standard.
entries.verification: The opened Game Developer report includes a named AIAS statement, the award criteria, and Miyamoto’s 1998 Hall of Fame induction.
entries.timeNote: Published at 04:15 Beijing time on November 17, inside the fixed edition window; the story says the ceremony is in February without supplying a year or exact date.

entries.headline: Coffee Stain acquires Chronicles: Medieval for DKK 36.75 million and keeps development alive
entries.summary: Coffee Stain signed an agreement to acquire the game’s intellectual property and related assets, placing development with a new company co-owned by Coffee Stain and key former Raw Power Games members. Coffee Stain will hold 75 percent, the former team 25 percent, and the PC project remains listed for 2027.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report distinguishes the signed agreement, price, ownership structure, continued development, and the still-unspecified release date.
entries.timeNote: Published at 13:13 Beijing time on November 16, inside the fixed edition window; the agreement was signed November 14.

entries.headline: Fake Grand Theft Auto VI download sites spread malware ahead of launch
entries.summary: Security company Cynet warns that sites claiming to offer PC, free, or early-access copies of Grand Theft Auto VI are proliferating. One 796KB executable tested in the report loaded malware targeting browser passwords, Steam credentials, and cryptocurrency wallets.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report separates Cynet’s warning, the writer’s observations, and an executed sample from the sites’ unverified claims.
entries.timeNote: Published at 17:59 Beijing time on November 16, inside the fixed edition window; the official launch date is November 19, 2026.
